Genpact LTD is recorded as a for-profit public company with the ticker G, CIK 0001398659, and headquarters in Hamilton, D0. The website associated with it is generali.com, and the text drawn from that site describes Assicurazioni Generali Group rather than Genpact. That text presents the site as the corporate website of Assicurazioni Generali Group, offering information on its activities, financial data, news, CSR, career opportunities, and history, alongside storytelling on topics of general interest. The company describes a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence" that it says will further enhance excellence across its customer relationships, its Group operating model, and its core capabilities.

The held facts list no AI products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for Genpact LTD. The name and ticker in the company record do not match the Assicurazioni Generali Group material on the linked site, and the data contains nothing further on what Genpact itself does or sells.
